notes.title: Double quality
notes.content: The game quality has been raised to the highest quality that the graphics card can handle, and some things within the game have been improved for smoother gameplay, and some minor bugs have been fixed in preparation for the next huge update.

notes.title: The Angel’s Bane – A Challenge of Shadows
notes.content:
A new terror has taken root in The Devil Ball. Upon reaching the 10th raid, a towering Angel’s Tree appears in your village—its origins unknown, its presence unnatural. But it has drawn the attention of the Devil Moon Eyes, creatures that watch… and hunt.

Your mission is clear: Cut the tree down. But one wrong move, one moment in their sight, and your fate is sealed. Stay in the shadows, move with precision, and defy the gaze of the abyss.

Are you ready for the challenge? Or will the Devil Moon Eyes claim you as their next victim?

Take on the event now and prove your survival instincts!

notes.title: Small bugs fixed
notes.content: There was a minor bug with the village spirit where it wouldn't kill the enemy when touched, so it's been resolved.

notes.title: Son of the developer
notes.content: An internal event has been added to the player's village, which is activated after passing the fourth raid. A huge and terrifying entity will appear, covered in terrifying Assyrian talismans, and a huge number of monsters coming from behind it. Your mission is to eliminate it to pass the sixth raid. You may need a large number of cannons, so do not forget to visit the cannon store after collecting some money.

notes.title: The Blue Moon Invasion – A Ramadan Special
notes.content:
Celebrate Ramadan with the exclusive "Rise of the Blue Moon" event in The Devil Ball. This major update introduces a new raid type, accessible via the Events section in your settings. The peaceful life of the Sacred Mountain Village is disrupted as massive portals emerge, unleashing hordes of menacing creatures. Players must harness their strategic skills to upgrade village defenses, recruit brave warriors, and utilize unique abilities to safeguard the village's spirit—a burning ball—from these relentless foes. Engage in this time-limited event to experience new challenges, earn exclusive rewards, and immerse yourself deeper into the enchanting world of magical orbs.

This update not only adds fresh content but also reinforces our commitment to providing engaging experiences that resonate with our diverse player community.

notes.content:

notes.title: Update settings
notes.content: Added audio settings to the menu and reduced the end time of the main story scene.

notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.content: Four achievements have been added to the cannons within the game. You will get them after purchasing each cannon from the cannon store.

notes.title: Bug fixes and new additions
notes.content:
Update Notes:
We've released a new update with several fixes and exciting additions:

Fixes:

Adjusted the Double cannon to function correctly.


Additions:

Introduced the new Thorn Cannon.

Added a Money Field to all shops within the game.


We hope you enjoy the new features! Your feedback is always appreciated.
